864-4875-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
864-4875-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Conspiracy, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Eternal Witness token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

4863-5929-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
4863-5929-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Leyline of Transformation, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Revolutionist token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

requires.n: Soul Sister (Gain life when a creature enters)

4399-4518-7056--228.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Stormscape Familiar.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, the "Soul Sister" card triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and the Soul Sister trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Soul Sister trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
4399-4518-7056--228.notes:
The infinite lifegain, infinite lifeloss, and infinite energy counter results are only produced by specific soul sister effects.

If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

401-2530-3944-6634.easyPrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
Your life total is at least 2.
401-2530-3944-6634.description:
Cast Blood Pet by paying {B}.
When Blood Pet enters the battlefield, Carnival of Souls triggers, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
When Blood Pet dies, Decaying Soil and Al Bhed Salvagers trigger.
Resolve the Decaying Soil trigger, causing you to pay {1} to return Blood Pet from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Al Bhed Salvagers trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Repeat.

5184-5742-5743-8242.description:
Activate Songbird by discarding Gilded Assault Cart.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Songbird ability.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

647-2023-4518-6006.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kor Skyfisher and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1479-2841-6517-8102.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Windswept Heath.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1479-2841-6517-8102.description:
Fetch a land using Windswept Heath.
When the fetched land enters, Dragonback Assault and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Dragonback Assault trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Dragonback Assault from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Dragonback Assault triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

728-2185-6972.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Howlgeist
When Howlgeist dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Howlgeist
When Howlgeist dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Grimgrin abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
728-2185-6972.notes: If Howlgeist starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

1829-1981-2415-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a creature, adding one mana of any color
When the creature dies, Vindictive Vampire and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Vindictive Vampire trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat.

2301-2738-4871-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Abzan Ascendancy, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Abzan Ascendancy trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1.
Repeat.

824-2292-2728-6012.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
Leech Bonder is tapped and does not have summoning sickness.
824-2292-2728-6012.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
824-2292-2728-6012.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Leech Bonder's ability by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Reluctant Role Model and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Reluctant Role Model trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat from step 4.

431-2557-4365-7824.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven untapped Merfolk.
431-2557-4365-7824.description:
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven untapped Merfolk, countering that spell.
Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating a total of eight 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Repeat.

2447-3259-3480.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Infestation Expert // Infested Werewolf as attackers.
Infestation Expert // Infested Werewolf triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

765-1479-7705.description:
Play Guildless Commons.
When Guildless Commons enters the battlefield, it, Mole Man, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Mole Man trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Guildless Commons from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Guildless Commons enters the battlefield, it and Mole Man trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

1274-3188-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-3188-7690--165.description:
Gain life.

Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Social Climber triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

When Old-Growth Educator dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Old-Growth Educator enters, it triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

457-2797-4321-6291.description:
Activate Retrofitter Foundry's fourth ability by tapping it and sacrificing a Thopter, creating a 4/4 Construct artifact creature token, a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token, and a Food token.
Activate Urza's first ability three times by tapping the Thopter, Construct and Food, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Retrofitter Foundry's first ability by paying {3}, untapping it.
Repeat.

Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

When the Faerie enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.

2034-6528-7084.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Elfsworn Giant triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

640-2173-5010-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Golgari Thug.
When Golgari Thug dies, it and Dross Harvester trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Thug trigger, putting it from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Dross Harvester trigger, causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Cast Golgari Thug from the top of your library by paying 2 life.
Repeat.

2946-4050-5477.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Cult Conscript, adding {B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating a creature token and putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2457-3480-4289-6705.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

38-659-5295.notablePrerequisites: You control a number of Goblins that is equal to or greater than six plus Krenko's commander tax.
38-659-5295.description:
Activate Krenko by tapping it, creating a number of 1/1 Goblin creature tokens equal to the number of Goblins you control.
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing Krenko, adding {R}.
Choose to return Krenko to the command zone from your graveyard.
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing a Goblin, adding {R}.
Repeat step 4 until you have enough mana to cast Krenko.
Cast Krenko from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{R} plus commander tax.
Repeat.

428-1694-2770-3604.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to deal exactly two or three damage to an opponent.
You have enough mana to cast Donate.
428-1694-2770-3604.description:
Cast Donate by paying its mana cost, giving control of Gisela to an opponent.
Cast Ghyrson Starn by paying {1}{U}{R}.
When Ghyrson Starn enters the battlefield, Cadric triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Ghyrson Starn with haste.
Deal exactly two or three damage to the opponent, which is reduced to one by Gisela, triggering Ghyrson Starn and the Ghyrson Starn token.
Resolve the nontoken Ghyrson Starn's trigger, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
The token Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
The nontoken Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Repeat from step 6.

957-2061-2187.description:
Cast Time Stretch by paying its mana cost, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Possessed Skaab.
When the Possessed Skaab token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Stretch from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat during your second turn.

2608-4499-5614.easyPrerequisites: Bighorner Rancher does not have summoning sickness.

When Derevi enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Bighorner Rancher.

Xyris' first ability triggers, creating two 1/1 Snake creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Snake, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

539-2232-2374-3558.description:
Cast Crookshank Kobolds by paying {0}.
When Crookshank Kobolds enters the battlefield as a Forest land due to Ashaya, it and Maja trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing to return nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Maja trigger, creating a 1/1 Human Warrior creature token.
When the Human Warrior enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Crookshank Kobolds to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

1765-2557-2733-4050.description:
Cast Shimmering Wings by paying {U}, attaching it to any creature you control.
Shimmering Wings enters the battlefield, triggering Chishiro, creating two 2/2 Spirit creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing both Spirit tokens, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Shimmering Wings' second ability by paying {U}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

205-4428.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Thassa triggers, blinking Azor.
Azor enters the battlefield, preventing opponents from casting instants or sorceries during their next turn.
Repeat during each of your turns.

539-3340-3713.notablePrerequisites: Steelfin Whale does not have summoning sickness.
539-3340-3713.description:
Activate Steelfin Whale by tapping it, creating a Treasure token.
The Treasure enters the battlefield, triggering Steelfin Whale, untapping Steelfin Whale.
Repeat.

1977-4013-4659.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Tivit.
Tivit enters the battlefield, causing you to create at least two Treasure and/or Clue tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing two Treasure and/or Clue tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

3026-4302-4802-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing an Angel.
Bishop of Wings triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
The Spirit enters the battlefield with at least two +1/+1 counters and becomes a 4/4 Spirit Angel due to having a +1/+1 counter on it.
Bishop of Wings triggers, causing you to gain four life.
Resolve Altar of Dementia's ability, causing target player to mill a number of cards equal to the sacrificed Angel's power.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the Spirit token.
Repeat from step 2.

360-1734-4279-4681.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying {1}{W}{W}.
Fiend Hunter enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Soul Warden.
Resolve the Fiend Hunter trigger, exiling Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Soul Warden trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
Fiend Hunter triggers, returning Karmic Guide from exile to the battlefield.
Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Soul Warden.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Fiend Hunter enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Soul Warden.
Resolve the Fiend Hunter trigger, exiling Karmic Guide.
Resolve both remaining Soul Warden triggers, causing you to gain two life.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability from step 5, putting a -1/-1 counter on up to one creature and drawing a card.
Repeat from step 5.
